svg.title: MediCare Tracker — architecture
svg.desc: MediCare Tracker: Prescription and dose tracking · three services. Patients miss doses. This gives doctors, patients and staff role-based dashboards, slot-based prescriptions and a chatbot that reads the patient's own data.

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
